reduceLogs.detailHtmlHeadline: Unexpected hosting response (HTML instead of API data)
reduceLogs.detailHtmlBody: The request to /api/trpc should return JSON; an HTML page was returned — common with timeouts, 502/503 or a restarting service (e.g. Render). Batch processing may continue in the background: wait 30–60 s and use “Try again”. If it persists, open service logs in the hosting panel and check memory, restarts and errors.

reduceLogs.wakeHintHtml:
On free hosting the container may be “cold starting” after inactivity (30–60+ s). The batch ID appears in the chip above once created.

Typical after sending .7z / .zip: the batch exists but file list appears only after extraction and first events. General status is below — wait or check logs.
reduceLogs.hintAfterExtract: The tracking table lists logs after extracting the archive on the server (not the .7z itself).
reduceLogs.hintDetailFailed: Batch detail failed; if the chip shows the ID try Try again. If not listed yet, open the Dashboard.
reduceLogs.hintNoLotChooseFiles: No batch in this view: choose files above and run Run reduction with upload, or
reduceLogs.hintPasteBatchIdSuffix: if the batch was already created.
reduceLogs.hintReloadTracked: If you submitted and reloaded, monitored batches come from the browser — without the chip above, add the batch from the Dashboard or upload again. In production a long refresh may occur while the service starts.
reduceLogs.listProgressNoDetail: {{pct}}% (list) — batch detail unavailable; use Try again if needed.
reduceLogs.stdoutStarting: Starting line read aggregation (wait for first checkpoint)…
reduceLogs.forgeLocalBadge: Run finished without uploading to remote storage (Forge). Processing and metrics were generated normally — use download links below for server-held copy when available.
reduceLogs.filterNoRows: No files match the current filter.
reduceLogs.gridColReduceTitle: Only after completion: volume reduction %. While processing follows file read progress (0–100%).

reduceLogs.reduceProgressTitle: Read/heuristic progress until done; then shows volume reduction

reduceLogs.criticalSignalsSummary: Critical signals: {{susp}} suspicious events and {{trg}} triggers preserved.
reduceLogs.noEventsYet: This file's events appear here as the backend registers reduction steps for the current batch.
reduceLogs.awaitingFirstBatchState: Waiting for the first batch state from the server…
reduceLogs.spinColdStartHint: On free hosting the container may be “waking” after idle time (30–60+ s). The batch ID stays in the chip above once created.
reduceLogs.batchActiveLoadingTitle: Active batch on server (file list loading)
reduceLogs.batchWaitingFileTableHint: Common when sending a .7z / .zip: the batch exists, but the per-file list appears only after extraction and the first events. General status is below; wait or check the log.
reduceLogs.emptyBatchResponseBanner: The server returned an empty response for batch <mono>{{id}}</mono>. It may not exist for this account, or is not indexed yet. <dash>Open Dashboard</dash> to confirm.
reduceLogs.manyLotsSavedWithLink: There are {{n}} batch(es) saved in this browser. The list stays in the panel above; you do not lose the previous one when submitting another. See everything on the Dashboard
reduceLogs.hintAfterExtractStrong: The tracking table lists logs after extraction of the archive on the server (not the .7z itself).
reduceLogs.awaitRowTrans: Waiting for this batch row in the list (refresh ~10 s)…
reduceLogs.hintDetailFailedTrans: Batch detail failed; if the chip above shows the ID, try <retry>Try again</retry> in the notice. If the list still does not show the batch, open the Dashboard.
reduceLogs.hintNoLotFilesTrans: No batch in this view yet: pick files above and use <run>Run reduction with upload</run>, or <dash>open the Dashboard</dash> if the batch was already created.

monitor.interpretFailed: The flow stopped before final consolidation — resubmit or review the file.
monitor.interpretUploadLarge: Chunked upload still in progress; multi-GB archives may take longer before analytical queue.
monitor.interpretUploadSmall: File is still being sent to the server and has not entered heuristic stage yet.
monitor.interpretQueuedReused: File was reused from the server and is queued on the current batch; next update should show heuristic read without re-upload.
monitor.interpretQueuedFresh: File was fully received and waits for heuristic stage of the batch.
monitor.interpretRunning: Reduction is underway; final read depends on completing current stage in the ops panel.
monitor.interpretSignals: Reduction retained signals relevant for triage and investigation priority.
monitor.interpretNeutral: Reduction finished without explicit critical highlights — contextual review needed before verdict.
monitor.recoFailed: Resend this log only, verify file integrity and that inferred type matches Contradef artefact.
monitor.recoUploadLarge: Keep tab open until chunked upload reaches 100%; processing only starts after full batch receipt.
monitor.recoUploadSmall: Follow upload progress (bar or %) until 100% before expecting reduction metrics or preserved events.
monitor.recoQueuedReused: Do not re-send this file. Watch batch queue and wait for switch to heuristic read in this panel.
monitor.recoQueuedFresh: Upload finished. Wait for batch queue transition to heuristic read in this panel.
monitor.recoRunning: Use current stage and ops message to see if file is in read, heuristic filter or reduced output consolidation.
monitor.recoSignals: Prioritize this log in analysis — triggers and critical signals were preserved for behaviour interpretation.
monitor.recoNeutral: Finish context review and compare with other logs before closing assessment.
monitor.stepAwaitReprocess: Waiting for reprocess of persisted artefact
monitor.msgPrepareSession: Preparing upload session (contacting server) — no bytes sent yet from {{fileName}}.
monitor.msgProcessing: File {{fileName}} is in heuristic processing on the current batch.
monitor.msgCompleted: File {{fileName}} processed and consolidated for review.
monitor.msgReusedWait: File {{fileName}} reused from server, waiting for reprocess start.
